Skill Progression Plan: Transitioning from Traditional Sketching to Digital Illustration

Goal:
To successfully transition from traditional sketching to creating full digital illustrations by building a portfolio of 10 high-quality digital pieces within four months.

Timeline: 4 Months

Month 1: Foundation and Tool Mastery
- Goal: Become comfortable with digital tools and replicate traditional techniques digitally.
- Milestones:
  - Week 1: Select and set up digital art software (e.g., Photoshop, Procreate, Clip Studio Paint) and hardware (tablet).
  - Week 2: Practice basic digital brush settings, layers, and undo functions.
  - Week 3: Recreate 2 traditional sketches digitally to understand line weight and pressure sensitivity.
  - Week 4: Complete 1 simple digital illustration focusing on composition and basic coloring.
- Deliverable: 1 completed digital piece.

Month 2: Color and Lighting Techniques
- Goal: Develop proficiency in digital coloring, shading, and lighting effects.
- Milestones:
  - Week 5: Study color theory and practice creating color palettes digitally.
  - Week 6: Practice shading techniques using layer modes (Multiply, Overlay, etc.).
  - Week 7: Create 2 digital illustrations focusing on dramatic lighting and mood.
  - Week 8: Refine previous works and add details to enhance depth.
- Deliverable: 3 new digital pieces (Total: 4).

Month 3: Style Development and Complexity
- Goal: Experiment with different styles and increase the complexity of illustrations.
- Milestones:
  - Week 9: Analyze favorite digital artists and attempt to mimic their style in 1 piece.
  - Week 10: Work on a more complex composition with multiple characters or elements.
  - Week 11: Focus on texture and background details to add realism or stylized flair.
  - Week 12: Complete 2 digital illustrations showcasing personal style evolution.
- Deliverable: 2 new digital pieces (Total: 6).

Month 4: Portfolio Completion and Polish
- Goal: Finalize the portfolio with high-quality pieces and prepare for presentation.
